action.name: Repeated typed HyperBoost reversible validation
action.value: Balanced mode 0 to HyperBoost mode 7 on both channels, then exact Balanced restoration with the exact cooling pad present

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully: both mode-7 setters returned status-02 semantic acknowledgements.
validation.readbackResult: Readback confirmed mode 7/value 0 independently on both thermal channels.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully: the saved Balanced pair was submitted once and acknowledged on both channels.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Restoration readback confirmed the exact saved mode 0/value 0 state on both channels.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The repeat run confirmed the exact laptop and BIOS, the exact PID 0F43 revision-0200 report-ID-5 cooling pad, inactive competing controllers, the full-power 280 W adapter state, and paired Balanced/Automatic laptop state before mutation.
The validator submitted exactly one mode-7 write per channel, received both acknowledgements, and independently read mode 7/value 0 from both channels.
The validator restored the saved Balanced pair exactly once, received both acknowledgements, and independently read the exact saved state from both channels.

limitations: This repeat validates the same exact-device, pad-present HyperBoost transition as the earlier admitted run. It does not expand support to another laptop model, cooling-pad revision, or pad-less use.
The laptop and cooling-pad checks are correlated across a bounded multi-device run; no raw device path or serial is committed.
No sustained workload, benchmark, pad-less activation, or long-duration thermal validation was performed.
The private typed transcript remains uncommitted.

productionAdmission.reason: A second exact-device run reproduced the acknowledged paired apply, independent mode-7 readback, exact saved-state restoration, and paired restoration readback without retry or manual recovery.

notes: USBPcap was not running during the typed validation.
The installed OpenBlade service was not started.
Razer Game Manager Service 3 and Razer Elevation Service were restored after the bounded run.
